args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails: `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
Changed `round_money` in `src/money.py` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the documented behavior and FIN-212 requirement.

Example: `2.665` now rounds to `2.66` (banker's rounding) instead of `2.67`.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
